_source: Claw-ZS (Hataway et al., arXiv:2607.02813; github olsenlab-science/Claw-ZS impedance_data/2025-08-19). Lock-in reduction of the deposited Tektronix traces from the 2026-10-06 bare-solver pass (derived/impedance_refit.json, sha of that pass's zip in arxiv _papers/results_2026-10-06/SHA256SUMS). |Z| is at the DEPOSITED scale (R_s = 0.1 ohm), which is 10x below the paper; the x10 reading is a hypothesis. Phase is scale-free. Split: held_out (score only).
